<passage n="00" section="Control box">
SGW  SUPPLY CHAIN AND LOGISTICS

OB-24-04
OPERATIONS BULLETIN 24-04: INTERIM FUEL RESERVE AT DEPOTS

+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Document: OB-24-04                                                                           |
| Effective: 2024-07-08                                                                        |
| Expires: 2024-08-31                                                                          |
| Owner: Supply Chain and Logistics                                                            |
| Subject Matter Expert: Faircloth, Nadia S.                                                   |
| Classification: SGW Internal - Controlled                                                    |
| Approved: Logistics Section Chief; Manager, Supply Chain, Huggins, Delmar J., 2024-07-03     |
| Approved: Water Incident Lead; Manager, Water Distribution, Sistrunk, Odell M., 2024-07-05   |
| Applies to: SC, GA systems                                                                   |
+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
</passage>
<passage n="01" section="1. PURPOSE; 2. BACKGROUND; 3. DIRECTION">
1. PURPOSE

Hold an interim diesel reserve at SGW depots from 2024-07-08 to 2024-08-31.

2. BACKGROUND

Altamaha Fuel & Lube advised on 2024-07-01 that its Augusta-area rack is on reduced allocation
through August. The 18 h delivery commitment in contract MAL-CTR-0447 still applies. This
bulletin adds an SGW-held reserve so that early-season events do not depend on the vendor alone.

3. DIRECTION

3.1 Each depot below shall hold at least the reserve shown at all times.

3.2 Draw on the reserve only for standby and portable generators at water and critical
    facilities.

3.3 FTK-WREN-3 shall be returned to DEP-AIK-GRANITEVILLE full at the end of each shift.

3.4 Report depot levels to the Logistics desk every Monday by 10:00.

3.5 If a depot falls below its reserve, order a refill on F-MAL-022 the same day.

+----------------------+---------------+---------------------+
| Depot                | Reserve (gal) | Tank capacity (gal) |
+======================+===============+=====================+
| DEP-AIK-GRANITEVILLE | 4,800         | 8,000               |
| DEP-RCH-PHINIZY      | 3,200         | 6,000               |
| DEP-RLD-CONGAREEBEND | 2,500         | 5,000               |
+----------------------+---------------+---------------------+
</passage>
<passage n="02" section="4. EXPIRY">
4. EXPIRY

This bulletin expires 2024-08-31 unless reissued. MAL 05.040 applies unchanged after expiry.

Contact: Logistics desk 803-641-3315; after hours EOC Logistics desk 803-641-3300.
</passage>
</document>
Write one header per passage, in passage order.
